links.comparator_used: The same flagged plans before PSQA measurement and re-optimization; the deployed Poka Yoke system ran automated daily checks of approved plans and emailed planners when a plan was at risk.
links.outcome: Detection and remediation of VMAT plans at risk of PSQA failure.
links.effect: The Poka Yoke system analyzed 1722 VMAT plans; 29 (1.7 %) were marked at risk; after PSQA measurements, 9 out of 29 were actual failures and were re-optimized so that they were no longer ranked at risk.
links.tradeoff: False-positive workload was reported: only 9 of 29 marked plans were actual failures. The model sensitivity was low (0.39) despite specificity of 0.99; calculations took less than 30 s per plan.
links.quote: After the PSQA measurements, 9 out of 29 plans were found to be actual failures and were re-optimized such that they were no longer ranked at risk.

design_hint: ML-based complexity monitoring with targeted PSQA and plan re-optimization
